newsitem.title: UK: British Biotech shares squeezed up 12 pct.
newsitem.headline: British Biotech shares squeezed up 12 pct.

text.p: Shares in British Biotech Plc jumped 12 percent in midafternoon trading on Thursday following a squeeze on the stock earlier in the session, analysts said.
Shares in the company were up 25 pence at 233 1/2 pence at 1511 GMT after hitting a high of 235 pence.

One analyst, who asked not to be named, said a number of sell positions on the stock in recent weeks had been unwound, prompting the recovery. British Biotech shares have risen 20 percent from their 1997 low of 194 pence on January 10.
There were also unconfirmed reports of a favourable brokerage visit to the Oxford-based company earlier this week.
British Biotech is best known for its novel anti-cancer drug Marimastat, which is currently undergoing Phase III trials. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
